title: SCOPE-D OSINT Passive Lookup
description: Output record for a passive OSINT lookup (DNS, WHOIS, certs, BGP). No network scanning, no active probing, no credential access. All external calls are to public-source APIs (CT logs, WHOIS, DNS resolvers, BGP registries). Part of the OSIRIS capability recovery path — see docs/osiris-recon-capability-recovery-backlog.md §3 (passive lookup fixtures).

lookupId.description: Unique identifier for this lookup record.

lookupType.description: The type of passive public-source lookup performed.

target.description: The lookup target (domain, IP, ASN, or MAC prefix).

targetScope.description: Scope classification of the target. fixture_only means no live external contact.

engagementPolicyRef.description: Reference to the EngagementPolicy document authorizing this lookup.

authorizationRef.description: Reference to the authorization document or statement permitting this lookup.

executionMode.description: How the lookup was executed. 'fixture' means no live network call was made.

nonDestructiveOnly.description: Must always be true. Passive lookups must never cause side effects on the target.

networkBoundary.description: Describes the network access boundary for this lookup.

sourceEvidenceRef.description: The public source queried (e.g. 'crt.sh CT log', 'IANA WHOIS', 'system DNS resolver').

operatorIdentityRef.description: Identity of the operator who authorized this lookup.

receiptRequired.description: Must always be true. Every lookup emits a receipt.

fixtureMode.description: True if this is a fixture-mode run with no live external contact.

records.description: Structured lookup results. Empty for fixture_only or denied status.

raw.description: Raw response text for debugging. Omit for denied or fixture_only.

sourceVersion.description: Source dataset version or timestamp if available.

confidenceCaveat.description: Caveat about result confidence or staleness.

error.description: Error message if status is error.

receiptEmitted.description: True once the receipt has been written.

actionDeniedReceipt.description: If the lookup was denied, reference to the denial receipt.

actionAuthorizedReceipt.description: If the lookup was authorized, reference to the authorization receipt.
